question: Show Renal cell trials using PD-L1 where PD‑L1 positivity was an inclusion criterion.

gemini.answer: Returns RCC trials using PD-L1 inhibitors where PD-L1 positivity was an inclusion criterion.
gemini.assumptions: Assuming PD-L1 positivity being an inclusion criterion is represented by a non-null value in the "pdl1_inclusion" column.
gemini.raw: {"sql":"SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"ici_class\", \"cancer_type\", \"pdl1_inclusion\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" = 'RCC' AND \"ici_class\" = 'PD-L1' AND \"pdl1_inclusion\" IS NOT NULL;","answer":"Returns RCC trials using PD-L1 inhibitors where PD-L1 positivity was an inclusion criterion.","assumptions":"Assuming PD-L1 positivity being an inclusion criterion is represented by a non-null value in the \"pdl1_inclusion\" column."}
